correctness.rationale: For center-selected sets, the grounded follower matrix is diagonal. For center-follower sets, an arrowhead Schur complement equals the total selected conductance and yields the stated inverse-trace formula. Every nonprefix set is strictly dominated either by adding the center in place of a stronger selected leaf or by swapping that leaf for an unselected weaker leaf, with the two cases partitioned by a positive algebraic threshold. Direct subtraction proves the two-candidate choice, including all budgets and ties. Exact-rational independent matrix inversions verify the formulas for 4,992 cases, and exhaustive minima for 1,248 cases support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: All-budget exact leader optimization on a natural unbounded-degree branching graph with arbitrary positive edge weights is a motivated network optimization problem. The result reduces exponential selection to one sort and linear scan, and gives a strict three-budget reentrance of center leadership; these structural consequences are not generic matrix-algebra exercises and can guide exact benchmark instances and network design.
